title: Continuous degree-(0,2) pairing from an equivariant bilinear map
statement: Let k be a field, G a group, Ω=AlgebraicClosure ℚ, r:G→Autℚ(Ω) a group homomorphism, and A,B,N k-representations of G. Suppose φ:A→ₗ[k]B→ₗ[k]N satisfies φ(s·a,s·b)=s·φ(a,b) for every s∈G, a∈A, b∈B. Write Vᴳ for the invariant subspace, Z²lev(V)=levelCocycles₂ r V, H²(V)=continuousH2 r V, and πV=continuousH2π r V. There exists a bilinear map P:Aᴳ×H²(B)→H²(N) such that for every m∈Aᴳ and z∈Z²lev(B), there is e∈Z²lev(N) satisfying e(s,t)=φ(m,z(s,t)) for every s,t∈G and P(m,πB(z))=πN(e). No trivial-action, normality, or finite-index assumption is required.
lean_statement: ∀ {k G : Type} [Field k] [Group G] (r : G →* (AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (A B N : Rep.{0} k G) (φ : A →ₗ[k] B →ₗ[k] N), (∀ (s : G) (a : A) (b : B), φ (A.ρ s a) (B.ρ s b) = N.ρ s (φ a b)) → ∃ P : A.ρ.invariants →ₗ[k] groupCohomology.continuousH2 r B →ₗ[k] groupCohomology.continuousH2 r N, ∀ (m : A.ρ.invariants) (z : groupCohomology.levelCocycles₂ r B), ∃ e : groupCohomology.levelCocycles₂ r N, (∀ st : G × G, (e : G × G → N) st = φ (m : A) ((z : G × G → B) st)) ∧ P m (groupCohomology.continuousH2π r B z) = groupCohomology.continuousH2π r N e
